bb.ready.text: Hi, I'm Brix! Let's build a bridge, test it, and make it better!

bb.back.text: Welcome back, engineer! The river is waiting.

bb.story.intro1.text: Last night a big storm washed the village bridge away!

bb.story.intro2.text: Now the school bus can't get across the river.

bb.story.intro3.text: Brix is an engineer. Budge holds the budget.

bb.story.intro4.text: Build a bridge that's strong enough, and doesn't cost too much!

bb.story.between2.text: The scooters are crossing. Next come the cars.

bb.story.between4.text: Brix tests every bridge. Each test shows what to fix next.

bb.story.between6.text: Cars and vans are crossing. The school bus is next!

bb.story.outro1.text: The school bus rolls safely across!

bb.story.outro2.text: You tested, fixed and kept to the budget, just like a real engineer.

bb.prompt.tutorial.text: Put a wood plank in the gap. Then press Test!

bb.prompt.build.text: Build a bridge for the {vehicle}. Keep it under budget!

bb.prompt.deep.text: The middle is too deep for pillars. Build one for the {vehicle}!

bb.prompt.improve.text: This bridge sagged. Can you fix it?

bb.test.sag.text: That span is bending. Let's make it stronger.

bb.test.gap.text: The road has a hole. Put a deck in every gap first.

bb.praise.1.text: You used triangles to make it strong!

bb.praise.3.text: You fixed just the weak part.

bb.praise.4.text: You planned short spans, and they made it stronger.

bb.praise.5.text: You chose a part that does the job and saves money!

bb.retry.1.text: Let's look at where it bent.

bb.hint.budget.text: Strong, but too expensive. Can a cheaper part do the job?

bb.hint.span.text: Long spans bend more. Add a support or a triangle.

bb.hint.ground.text: Our crew can't build pillars in the deep water here. Use the solid ground.

bb.hint.brace.text: Triangles help when they cover the whole span.

bb.hint.improve.text: Only one part sagged. Fix that part.

bb.hint.model.text: Here's one bridge that works. Watch it appear.

bb.hint.modelTap.text: Tap each glowing gap to build it. Then test it!

bb.help.start.text: A bridge has to be strong enough and cheap enough. Engineers balance both.

bb.help.support.text: Pillars make spans shorter, and shorter spans are stronger.

bb.help.triangle.text: Triangles don't squish out of shape. That makes them super strong.

bb.help.material.text: Steel is stronger than wood, but it costs more.

bb.help.budget.text: This is all the money we have. Let's spend it wisely.

bb.help.test.text: Test it, watch where it sags, then improve that part.

bb.idle.text: Pick a piece, then tap a gap.
